note: Niue's banking is Kiwibank's, through an agency branch in Alofi run with the Niue Development Bank (Kiwibank's own release on the renewed arrangement; the Government of Niue's joint release of 24 July 2026). Kiwibank's personal banking fees and limits (effective 14 May 2026) and its pages for its two personal credit cards (rendered 30 October 2026, as their rates load by script): the Zero Visa has no account fee and the Platinum Visa costs $25 every six months; both charge 12.90% a year on purchases and cash advances, give up to 55 interest-free days, add 1.85% to a transaction processed overseas, and charge $5 for a late payment. A caution for the register: Kiwibank describes its Niue service as 'designated transactional banking services', and the July 2026 release says even term deposits and notice savers weren't available on the island until then; no source read says its credit cards are offered to Niue residents, so this file's coverage of Niue rests on Kiwibank being the island's bank, not on a statement that its cards are sold there.
